protocol.noise: Independent case/channel Gaussian draws; same LC1 draw in both protocols; normalized per case/type
protocol.missing: Physical sensor failure persists across all three load acquisitions
protocol.physics_subset: First test IDs from fixed random split; includes healthy, one- and two-member damage
protocol.classification: RF uses vote >=0.5; inverse refinement uses estimated stiffness loss >=0.05
protocol.limits: Known same-model geometry/load; unchanged damage across acquisitions; one training seed; no hardware transfer validation
